intent: Compare merge-base..HEAD changed files against a declared CBSP21/RPMCC24 scope manifest. Fail loud when the check cannot be performed.

acceptance.behavior: A changed file that is declared in scope produces no contamination finding.
A changed file not declared in scope produces a contamination finding.
A pinned base that differs from the actual merge-base produces a base-drift finding.
Declared-scope coverage below 95% produces the summary/high-severity result.
A clean, fully covered scope produces zero findings.
Ordinary scans without review context remain silent (no findings).
Missing manifest, unresolved merge-base, shallow-clone failure, or failed git diff must fail loud — never return an empty pass.
